All 36 regenerated assemblies preserve 39,668 IL-verified bodies. CI covers 22,822 core/standalone cases per platform with the existing one Linux/three Windows skips and zero failures, plus 129 GUI passes each. Every one of the 845 standalone cases executes exactly once per platform under unchanged deadlines. Complete committed-source/generator binding passes. Original Node array/string length and Promise callback name enumerability expectations remain separately retained compiled differences with identical 996 and 1,136 metadata/IL bodies, excluded from passing output totals and requiring general-property/final audit disposition.
